en:
## New Features

- **Kimi usage quotas**: kimi.com / kimi.ai providers now show their remaining 5-hour window in the status bar, with the weekly and monthly limits in the details popover. Refreshed on demand rather than on a timer, so nothing polls upstream while Kimi is not in use
- **Storage scan runs in the background**: starting a scan no longer ties it to the page. Navigating away or closing the tab lets it finish, and coming back re-attaches to the running job — or reports the result (or the error) of one that ended while you were gone
- **Hand-arranged order inside directory groups**: narrators grouped under a shared working directory can be dragged into the order you want, and it now survives a narrator starting work (which rewrites the recency order the sidebar otherwise sorts by)
- **Adjustable animation durations**: the streaming per-character fade-in and the card fade-in are now sliders in Appearance settings, with 0 meaning instant
- **Local root CA for TLS**: HTTPS setup now generates a local CA plus a CA-signed server certificate instead of a one-off self-signed one, with custom SANs, CA download, and per-platform trust instructions
- **Detail-level menu in the narrator toolbar**: the render detail level (LOD) no longer requires the Alt+wheel gesture, and that gesture can be turned off in settings for setups where Alt+scroll collides with the OS

## Performance

- **Background task list and recent tabs are now incremental**: both used to re-fetch their entire state on a timer — the task list re-serialized every completed result of a narrator every few seconds (hundreds of KB on the main thread), and kept polling even with no panel open. Both now page through a cursor and receive WebSocket deltas
- **Concurrent readers share one upstream Kimi request**: a fresh page had no cache, so every reader started its own quota fetch. One refresh per stale window is now actually one

## Bug Fixes

- The file preview's loading spinner was frozen in place
- The first upward scroll past a fork boundary failed once before loading older history
- A tool card's progressive row reveal could paint its entire body at once instead of one batch per scroll, ignoring the node budget
- Freshly opened paragraphs and headings popped in without their fade during streaming; a short retry could conversely replay a fade over text you never watched arrive
- A reorder inside a directory group visibly sprang back for one round trip before settling
- Entries listed in a knowledge-hint card were not clickable, so the entry they name could not be opened from there
- An admin looking at a network error lost the one-click "test the current model" probe
- Cancelling a storage scan reported it as still running, and an immediate re-scan was silently refused until clicked twice
- Editing a compact summary that failed to save reported nothing, so the failure read as success
- Restoring recent tabs from a snapshot dropped hand-arranged directory positions
- Two skills of the same name could resolve differently between the list you see and the toggle you flip, so disabling one appeared to do nothing
- Kimi weekly and monthly limits could be mislabelled: an explicitly reported window now wins over an inferred one, and a calendar month is no longer mistaken for an unnamed extra window

## Refactoring

- **The virtual message list is now the only renderer.** The previous chunked list (~36k lines) is gone, along with its feature flag and its two REST endpoints. Everything it did that the virtual list did not — tool timing, subagent cards, the image-generation fix, the model probe, knowledge-entry links — was wired across first
- The Kimi usage endpoints are admin-only, matching the other provider routes; they reach out to a third party and report account-level quota
- Several source-level guards were re-anchored to match braces rather than fixed indentation. They had started failing for reasons unrelated to what they guard, which invites re-anchoring them to whatever passes
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- **Kimi 用量配额**：kimi.com / kimi.ai 渠道现在会在状态栏显示 5 小时窗口的剩余量，详情浮层列出周限额与月限额。按需刷新而非定时轮询，没在用 Kimi 时不会去打扰上游
- **存储扫描改为后台运行**：扫描不再绑定在页面上。离开页面或关掉标签页都不会中断它，回来时会重新接上正在运行的任务——若期间已经结束，则告知结果或失败原因
- **目录分组内可手动排序**：同一工作目录下聚合的叙述者可以拖成你想要的顺序，并且在某个叙述者开始工作后依然保持（此前这会重写侧边栏依据的近期顺序，手排位置随之丢失）
- **动画时长可调**：流式逐字淡入与卡片淡入的时长现在是外观设置里的滑块，0 表示立即显示
- **TLS 本地根 CA**：HTTPS 配置从一次性自签名升级为本地 CA 签发服务器证书，支持自定义 SAN、下载 CA 证书，并提供分平台的信任指引
- **叙述者工具栏新增详细程度菜单**：调整渲染详细程度（LOD）不再必须用 Alt+滚轮；在 Alt+滚动与系统手势冲突的环境下，该手势也可以在设置里关掉

## 性能优化

- **后台任务列表与最近标签改为增量驱动**：两者原先都在定时重取全量状态——任务列表每几秒把一个叙述者所有已完成的结果重新序列化一遍（数百 KB，占用主线程），而且即使没有打开任何面板也在持续轮询。现在改为游标分页 + WebSocket 增量
- **并发读者共用一次 Kimi 上游请求**：首次打开页面时没有缓存，于是每个读者各发一次配额请求。现在「每个陈旧窗口刷新一次」才真的是一次

## 修复

- 文件预览的加载图标不再是静止的
- 首次向上滚动越过分叉边界时会先失败一次，之后才加载更早的历史
- 工具卡的渐进展开可能一次性画出整个正文，而不是每次滚动展开一批，节点上限形同虚设
- 流式输出时新开的段落与标题会直接弹出、没有淡入；反过来，一次短重试可能对你并未看着它出现的文本重播淡入
- 目录分组内重排后，顺序会明显回弹一次，等落库后才稳定下来
- 知识提示卡里列出的条目无法点击，没法从那里打开它指向的条目
- 管理员看到网络错误时，失去了一键「测试当前模型」的入口
- 取消存储扫描后仍被报告为运行中，紧接着点重新扫描会被静默拒绝，需要点第二次
- 编辑压缩摘要保存失败时没有任何提示，看起来像是保存成功了
- 从快照恢复最近标签时会丢掉目录分组内的手排顺序
- 同名技能可能在「你看到的列表」与「你点的开关」之间解析到不同副本，导致禁用像是没生效
- Kimi 的周/月限额可能张冠李戴：上游明确报出的窗口现在优先于推断值，自然月也不会再被当成无名的额外窗口

## 重构

- **虚拟消息列表成为唯一渲染器。** 旧的分块列表（约 3.6 万行）已删除，连同它的功能开关与两个 REST 端点。它有而虚拟列表没有的能力——工具计时、子代理卡、图像生成修复、模型探测、知识条目跳转——都已先行接好
- Kimi 用量端点收敛为仅管理员可用，与其他渠道路由一致：它们会向第三方发起请求，返回的也是账号级配额
- 若干源码级守卫改为按括号匹配定位，不再依赖固定缩进。它们此前会因与所守护内容无关的原因失败，而那种失败最容易诱使后人把断言重新锚到「能通过」的地方
